milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the green wool blocks in the SW corner (centered around -5, 0, -5 relative to spawn) and face them, confirming visual observation. max_distance=16 allows detection from reasonable range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wool.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted item (yellow_carpet) ends up in the player's inventory. The recipe is 2 yellow wool → 3 yellow carpet, so checking for min_count=1 is sufficient to confirm crafting occurred. Yellow carpet is not in the starting inventory so its presence proves successful crafting.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the iron blocks in the NE corner (centered around 5, 0, 5 relative to spawn) and face them. max_distance=16 allows detection from reasonable range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the iron blocks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted item (torch) ends up in the player's inventory. The recipe is 1 coal + 1 stick → 4 torches. Checking for min_count=1 is sufficient to confirm crafting occurred. Torch is not in the starting inventory so its presence proves successful crafting.
